entryLinks.name: Rule Check - Allows 1 more Large then Normal

sharedRules.name: Spell - Riptide
sharedRules.description: Target an enemy model even if it is Engaged. The model is moved 3” (as directly and as far as possible) away from the caster, making Armour rolls if forced to Break Away as normal. The model must  then make a Nerve test. If it fails, it is Knocked-down. Models with Steady may roll to avoid this as normal.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Crushing Pressure
sharedRules.description: If the target suffers any wounds, they are pinned in place and cannot make any Walk or Run actions for the rest of this Round.

sharedRules.name: RISING TIDES (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when you activate a model. That model may EITHER add 2 to its Sp stat until the end of the Round OR, if it is Knocked-down, it may stand up for free. This ability may be used any number of times in a Round.

sharedRules.name: Vicious Swipe
sharedRules.description: When attempting to Break Away from a Giga, enemy models have a  -1 modifier when they make their Armour roll.

sharedRules.name: BOUNDER (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model is activated. Grants this model the Fly ability until the end of the Round.

sharedRules.name: EVASION (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model activates. Grants this model the Dodge and Parry abilities until the end of the Round.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Trident
sharedRules.description: A model hit with this weapon in Melee, is marked as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Net
sharedRules.description: Break away actions from this model are made rolling 2 dice for the Armour roll rather than the normal 1. Each failed roll causes a wound.

sharedRules.name: BATTLE RAGE (2)
sharedRules.description: If this model can Engage an enemy model with a follow-up move, it may Engage that model and initiate another Melee by using the ability to go into a Battle Rage. This model will not get any bonus dice for charging however. Once this second Melee has been resolved, mark this model as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Combined Fire
sharedRules.description: When involved in a Group Shoot Action, Riverguard models add +1 dice to their Ranged Attack roll if one or more other Riverguard models in the group fire at the same target. This includes any Riverguard Sentinels in the Group.

sharedRules.name: Kyron's Blessing
sharedRules.description: While within 6" of  one or more friendly Water Elementals, this model has its Ar value improved by 1 (e.g. 6+ becomes 5+).

sharedRules.name: Elemental  Mastery
sharedRules.description: You may take one additional Water Elemental in your warband beyond the limit for Large models normally allowed in the warband selection rules. In addition, this model may cast its Riptide spell as a short action instead of the normal long action.

sharedRules.name: Death from Above
sharedRules.description:
When this model uses its BOUNDER special ability and then performs a qualifying charge action in the same Round, it has Crushing Strength (2) in its subsequent
Melee attack. Use this ability before any attack dice are rolled.

sharedRules.name: Defensive Toxins
sharedRules.description: In the End Phase, any enemy models Engaged by the Dambuster automatically suffer one hit with Crushing Strength (2).

sharedRules.name: TONGUE LASH (2)
sharedRules.description:
Use during the model’s Turn to make a Ranged attack as follows: Range 9”, 2D8. Any model hit by the attack is not wounded but is moved directly (the shortest route) into base contact with the Dambuster’s
front arc and marked as Fatigued. The model’s front arc and base should be flush with the Dambuster’s. Models that were Knocked-down remain so. If it is not possible to move the model, or it is Large, the attack has no effect.

sharedRules.name: Fluid Defense
sharedRules.description: While within 2" of this model, friendly WARRIOR models have the Parry special rule.

sharedRules.name: SLAMBACK (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model declares a Retaliation before dice are rolled. Any hits the Retaliation scores are resolved with Crushing Strength (2).

sharedRules.name: Kraken's Call
sharedRules.description: While within 6" of this model, friendly models have the Unbreakable  and Bloodlust special rules.
